questions.stem: Why does increasing light intensity increase the rate of transpiration?

options.text: Light makes water molecules move faster
Light causes stomata to open wider, allowing more water vapour to escape
Light increases the temperature of the soil
Light breaks down water molecules in the leaf

questions.explanation: In brighter light, stomata open wider to allow carbon dioxide in for photosynthesis. This also allows more water vapour to escape from the leaf, increasing the rate of transpiration.
